foundation.name: Shared foundation
foundation.description: App theme, three presets, semantic visual roles and native motion tokens.

button-style.name: Button style
button-style.description: Primary, secondary and destructive button appearances with accessible press and disabled states.

card.name: Card
card.description: Shared semantic content surface with flexible view-builder content.

chip.name: Filter chip
chip.description: A labeled Boolean selection with caller-owned binding and selected semantics.

disclosure.name: Disclosure
disclosure.description: Native disclosure group styled with shared tokens and caller-owned expansion state.

status-label.name: Status label
status-label.description: Readable info, success, warning, error and loading states with semantic symbols.

async-button.name: Async button
async-button.description: Cancellable view-scoped async action with duplicate suppression and required error handling.

sheet.name: Sheet and bottom sheet
sheet.description: Native modal task presentation, resizing and dismissal.

confirmation.name: Confirmation and alert
confirmation.description: Short choices, destructive confirmations and blocking messages.

popover.name: Popover and menu
popover.description: Tap-accessible anchored choices and information with size-class adaptation.

navigation.name: Navigation and tabs
navigation.description: Native destination hierarchy, peer tabs and adaptive sidebar.

segmented-control.name: Segmented selection
segmented-control.description: Short mutually exclusive choices with native selection semantics.

toggle.name: Toggle and checkbox choice
toggle.description: Boolean settings or multiple list selections.

text-input.name: Text and password input
text-input.description: Native keyboard, autofill, focus, submission and inline validation.

search.name: Search and autocomplete
search.description: Native query entry and a separate selected result.

number-field.name: Stepper and slider
number-field.description: Bounded numeric entry with native accessibility adjustment.

animated-number.name: Animated number
animated-number.description: Localized changing metrics with an explicit Reduce Motion fallback.

progress.name: Loading and progress
progress.description: Honest indeterminate work or actual measured completion.

refresh.name: Pull to refresh
refresh.description: Async refresh using native scrolling and task completion.

editable-list.name: Reorder and swipe actions
editable-list.description: Native editing actions with accessible alternatives.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.description: User-driven horizontal paging while preserving native scrolling.

date-selection.name: Date selection
date-selection.description: Localized dates; range endpoints need explicit domain validation.

share-copy.name: Share and copy
share-copy.description: User-initiated sharing or copying with useful result feedback.

banner.name: Status banner
banner.description: Product-specific transient status; actionable errors persist.

chat-surface.name: Chat and task surface
chat-surface.description: App-specific messages, composer and explicit streaming/task state.

live-activity.name: Live Activity and Dynamic Island
live-activity.description: System Live Activity requiring its own extension and capabilities.
